porta-cabins.narrative: This specification is what you are actually buying, line by line. Nineteen of the thirty lines are product-specific to this cabin; eleven are SAMAN platform standards shared across the family. Use the tables to compare quotations item by item — frame section, sheet thickness, insulation density — rather than by total price alone. Final openings, colours, service loads and fit-out follow your approved drawing and quotation.
